title: azarolus crataegoides var. torulosa
intro: Azarolus crataegoides var. torulosa, commonly known as the "Persian service tree" or "Torulosa service tree", is a plant species belonging to the family Anacardiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Azarolus crataegoides var. torulosa include its ability to act as an astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, which may be beneficial in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide protection against oxidative stress and inflammation.
